query_text: Lava lamp bubble drift animation app for my phone where slow-moving glowing blobs float up and melt into each other in deep jewel tones — the whole vibe should feel warm, hypnotic, and totally satisfying to just stare at when you need to zone out.

Create a bouncing physics ball toy app that feels weighty and alive on mobile, where you can tilt or tap to shift the gravity so the ball rolls and ricochets off the walls in different directions — the ball should leave a soft trailing glow as it moves so the whole thing looks dreamy and satisfying.

Create a colour mixing and swirl paint toy app for mobile where you drag your finger across the screen and the colours bleed and swirl into each other like wet acrylic paint — the palette should feel rich and saturated, and the swirl trails should stay visible so you can build up a gorgeous layered canvas.

Newton cradle pendulum simulation app for phone where five polished silver balls hang in a row and you can flick one or more to set them swinging — the click sound and the smooth arc of the swing should feel crisp and oddly soothing, like having a real desktop toy in your pocket.

Build a meme generator tool for mobile where you pick any image from your camera roll, then type your caption text at the top and bottom in that classic bold white style — it should feel quick and fun to use, and let you instantly save or share the finished meme.

Create a photo enhancer app for mobile where you can clean up grainy or blurry shots — it should let you slide between the before and after so you can really see how much sharper and cleaner the image looks, with the whole thing feeling polished and satisfying to use.

Make a panorama stitching tool for mobile where you can load a series of overlapping photos and have them joined into one seamless wide shot, with a horizon-levelling step so the final image sits perfectly straight — the result should look like a proper cinematic landscape you'd actually want to share.

Create a GIF maker app for my phone where you pick a burst photo sequence from your camera roll and it turns the frames into a smooth, looping animated GIF — you should be able to adjust the speed so the motion feels just right, and the finished result should look polished enough to share anywhere.

Build a colour grading tool for mobile where you can apply beautiful LUT presets to your photos with one tap — the app should show a row of preview thumbnails so you can see exactly how each look feels on your image before committing, and the overall vibe should feel like a professional editing suite condensed onto your phone.

Create a graduation congratulations poster maker app for phone that feels genuinely celebratory and personal — pick a warm, elegant template, type in the graduate's name and school, and get something beautiful you'd actually want to print or share, not just another generic card.

Make a baby shower invitation designer app for mobile where it feels like you're crafting something truly personal — soft, dreamy colour palettes, a spot to add the baby's name and party details, and a handful of sweet illustrated styles to choose from so the finished invite feels like it came from a boutique stationery shop.

Create a thank-you card personaliser app for phone where you pick a style that feels genuinely warm and handcrafted — add your own message, maybe a little photo, and walk away with something that actually looks like you put thought into it rather than just firing off a text.

Build a real estate listing flyer tool for mobile where an agent can drop in a property photo, fill in the key details like price, beds, and contact info, and get a clean, good-looking flyer they can post online or hand out — it should feel sharp and professional on phone without needing any design skills.

Build a fundraising campaign visual creator app for mobile where you can put together compelling campaign graphics quickly — choose a bold, emotive style, add your cause headline and goal amount, and get imagery that actually makes people stop scrolling and want to donate.

Make a watch party app for mobile where you and your friends can all hit play at the exact same moment and feel like you're watching together even across different cities — a shared chat running alongside the video so the reactions feel live and in the moment, with a look that feels cosy and social rather than cold and technical.

Need a music player app for my phone that lets me set a loop between two specific points in a song so I can replay that perfect section over and over — the controls should feel clean and tactile, the kind of thing that feels good to use when you're learning a melody or just obsessing over one brilliant riff.

Create a song identifier app for mobile that listens to whatever music is playing around you and tells you the track and artist — it should feel like magic when the answer pops up, with a clean, atmospheric look that shows the album art big and beautiful once the song is found.

Create a DJ crossfade mixing app for mobile where you've got two tracks lined up side by side and a smooth slider to blend between them — the whole interface should feel dark and moody like a real club booth, with glowing waveforms and a satisfying physical feel when you drag the crossfader across.

Create a kids safe mode player app for mobile with a warm, cheerful look where parents can set up a curated playlist of age-appropriate videos and songs — big friendly icons, simple one-tap controls the kids can use themselves, and a cosy colour palette that feels welcoming and calm rather than overstimulating.

Make an email drip sequence writer tool for mobile that helps you craft a series of warm, well-timed emails for a campaign — you describe what you're selling and who you're talking to, and it lays out a sequence of messages that feel genuinely personal and nicely paced rather than spammy.

Create a short-form video hook generator app for mobile where you type in your content topic and get back a handful of punchy opening lines that actually make people stop scrolling — the whole tool should feel quick and inspiring to use, like having a witty creative partner in your pocket.

Need a sponsorship brief builder app for mobile that helps me put together a polished pitch document for potential sponsors — you fill in your audience size, content style, and what you're offering, and it assembles something that looks professional and compelling enough to actually land deals.

Need a creator media kit generator app for my phone where I can pull together all my stats, aesthetic, and brand vibe into one beautiful shareable document — it should look like something a boutique creative agency would produce, with room for photos, audience numbers, and a section that shows off my content style.

An affiliate link tracker app for mobile where all your active links live in one tidy place — you can see at a glance which ones are getting clicks and it auto-generates the right disclosure text so your posts stay honest and on-brand, with a clean aesthetic that feels like it belongs in a creator's toolkit.

Need a news feed reader app for my phone that pulls in stories from a few topics I actually care about and shows them in a clean, scrollable list — something that feels calm and curated rather than overwhelming, so I can catch up on what's happening without getting sucked into a rabbit hole.
